ALL FOUR claims uncited, and one asserts an ingredient the evidence leans against. Trading status OK: Tabelog 口コミ dated 2026/07 and 2026/05, オープン日 1962年, 11:00-19:00, 月曜定休, 予約不可, 10席. gf_confidence 'ask' is correct.
